/method/: The archive's method: how a claim earns one of the five words, how a nil is written and audited, how living people are handled, and why unresolved names are not merged.
/sources/: Every source the archive rests on, with whether the document itself was read or only an index to it, and what is not here yet.
/searched/: The search register: every search made, with the terms typed, the register and act, what was left unread (done or part), and what it returned, negatives included. The Atlas holds the marks; this holds the evidence.
/open-questions/: The open questions, each with the document that would settle it and where that document is.
/errands/: The records a comune, diocese or state archive holds and does not publish, and the letter each would need. None is recorded as sent.
/worklist/: The work list: what is being done, by whom and since when, including what was abandoned and why.
/corrections/: Every place a document and the family tree disagree, and every claim this archive published and took back.
/changes/: What moved and when, including what this archive got wrong.
/whats-new/: What was read, found and corrected lately, by source, newest first. Now also the What's new group's own page.
/documents/: The photographs and papers held in the family's own tree, saved down before the links expired.
/register-1879/: The Sicilian registers: nine annual indexes and six acts, hunting one man who is still missing. A deep dive now.
/queensland/: The Queensland register: the Registry's historical index searched by a father's or a mother's name. A deep dive now.
/briatico-tested/: The test of the 1697 claim: eleven generations to Briatico, four resting on nothing. A deep dive now.
/audit/: The audit of negatives: each nil re-read to ask what set its window. Now in Checks.
